title: Peaceful Ingleside Hideaway w/ Rooftop Terrace
description:
Find Inspiration in this Peaceful, Cozy, Contemporary Townhome in vibrant East Nashville. Spend the day exploring the many popular restaurant hot spots, endless coffee shops & fabulous bars all within 5-10 minutes of us. Return to enjoy a refreshing cocktail on the roof top terrace or whip up a nice dinner with an amazing view. Just mins from all that downtown Nashville has to offer, our place will comfortably sleep 6. Come enjoy our home away from home.

The space
Is a 4 story townhouse. You enter into the main living area, that includes the kitchen, dining area and living room. The couch converts to a queen bed.  Head on up to the 2nd floor to find the Master Suite with a queen bed, walk in closet and full bath with shower. Third floor is the guest suite with a full bed, walk-in closet (w/washer and dryer), full bath w/tub, and a pull out single mattress for an extra guest. Head on up the last flight of stairs to your own private oasis on the roof overlooking East Nashville.

**Doorbell and rooftop cameras for your safety

Guest access
Keypad door lock for contactless, keyless entry at your convenience. Parking lot and street parking available. Short walk to inside corridor unit with lots of privacy.

Other things to note
We have a 2-day minimum on weekends and only 1-day on weekdays. 3-day weekends have a 3-day minimum requirement and are subject to higher rates. Please inquire for holiday rates. All Fridays and Saturdays must be booked together.
